title: Multimodal & Cross-Modal Learning
blurb: CLIP, contrastive learning, vision-language models, VQA, audio representations, speech pipelines.

lecture.summary: Build multimodal systems from scratch — contrastive image-text learning (CLIP), visual question answering, cross-modal retrieval, image captioning (CNN+Transformer), audio-visual correspondence, and generative multimodal concepts — on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and synthetic paired datasets.
takeaways: Contrastive image-text learning (CLIP) and cross-modal retrieval.
Image captioning and visual question answering (CNN + Transformer).
Multimodal fusion strategies — and how to evaluate them honestly.

snippet.caption: CLIP: pull matching image/text together, push others apart.
